observer.description: Configuration settings for the Observer service.

connectURL.description: DEPRECATED: use connectMTLSGRPCTarget instead. URL of the Cofide Connect API.

connectMTLSGRPCTarget.description: gRPC target for the Connect API. One of connectMTLSGRPCTarget or connectURL is required.

connectMTLSServerName.description: Optional SNI override to use when calling the Connect API.

connectTrustDomain.description: DEPRECATED: use connectSPIFFEID instead. SPIFFE trust domain of the Cofide Connect API.

connectSPIFFEID.description: SPIFFE ID of the Cofide Connect API. One of connectSPIFFEID or connectTrustDomain is required.

resyncEnabled.description: Controls whether periodic resync is active.

resyncPeriod.description: Resync interval as a Go duration string.

replicaCount.description: Number of replicas for the Observer deployment.

tag.description: Image tag. Defaults to the chart's appVersion when empty.

fullnameOverride.description: Override for the fully-qualified app name.

create.description: Whether to create a service account.

automount.description: Whether to automount the service account token.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

name.description: Name of the service account to use. If empty and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the pod.

podLabels.description: Labels to add to the pod.

resources.description: CPU/memory resource requests and limits for the container.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe configuration for the container.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe configuration for the container.

volumes.description: Additional volumes to mount into the pod.

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the container.
